hero.description: Software Engineer focused on building modern and scalable web applications. Experienced in frontend and backend development, API integrations, database design, and delivering robust business-oriented solutions using React, TypeScript, Node.js and SQL technologies.

text: I am a Software Engineer with experience in the development, maintenance, and integration of web applications tailored to business needs.

I have contributed to building software solutions for production environments, participating in requirements analysis, technical documentation, feature design and implementation, as well as third-party service and API integrations.
I am passionate about creating functional, scalable, and high-quality products that deliver real value to users.
I am an analytical, proactive, and adaptable professional with a strong commitment to continuous learning, problem-solving, and teamwork.
I enjoy taking on new technological challenges and transforming complex requirements into efficient and sustainable solutions.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Throughout my career, I have gained experience with a wide range of technologies focused on modern web development. I specialize in building scalable, intuitive, and high-performance applications using tools that cover both frontend and backend development.
